Carry the record id once, in §6's lead line.

Must-fix: none. The maintainer's scenario — a weekly regression and a post-publish smoke that a PM session can schedule from this text, with the owed list computed instead of remembered — is executable from the head as written; the four findings tighten what the text leaves to the runner's choice and bring the §5 locator rule into line with the reader the PR lands.
